events.description: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation.
events.title: The Agenda

data.title: قناة ياس

data.description: تقدّم روتانا دراما مجموعة واسعة من الأعمال الدرامية، تجمع بين المسلسلات المصرية الحديثة والأعمال التركية المدبلجة لتناسب مختلف الأذواق.

events.description: ‫م1 ، ح25 : ‫يواجه مواطنون سوريون ولبنانيون العديد من القضايا والتحديات الاجتماعية في حياتهم اليومية، وهم يحاولون التغلب على العقبات التي تضعها الحياة في طريقهم.‬‬
events.title: المحافظة ١٥

events.description: ‫م1 ، ح25 : ‫بعد مقتل والد عرسان في نزاع عائلي على الميراث، يواجه العديد من القضايا والتحديات الاجتماعية في حياته اليومية، بينما يحاول التغلب على العقبات التي تضعها الحياة في طريقه.‬‬
events.title: اليتيم

events.description: ‫م1 ، ح25 : ‫‫يكتشف شمس أنه ابن وريث رجل ذي نفوذ كبير، ولكن لكي يتمكن من الحصول على ثروة والده، يجب عليه أن يفي بالشرط الوحيد الذي قام والده بوضعه.‬‬‬
events.title: بخمس أرواح

events.description: ‫م1 ، ح25 : ‫بعد خروجه من السجن، يعود غواص للبحث عن الكنز المفقود والانتقام من الاشخاص الذين دمروا حياته وخانوه، مما يقلب الأمور رأسا على عقب ويقود للعديد من المواقف غير المتوقعة.‬‬
events.title: النويلاتي

events.description: ‫م1 ، ح25 : ‫تجد سيدة أعمال ناجحة نفسها مطاردة من قبل ماضيها، إذ تبدأ الأسرار والأحداث القديمة بالظهور من جديد، مما يزعزع راحة بالها ويهدد مستقبلها.‬‬
events.title: على قد الحب

data.description: يأخذكم ست ماكس في رحلة إلى قلب السينما الهندية، من أقوى أفلام بوليوود الجديدة والكلاسيكية، مع ترفيه عائلي ممتع وأفلام تجمع كل العائلة على متعة واحدة.

events.description: ‫‫ينتقل حديثا العهد بالزواج كارثيك وأنو إلى شقة قديمة، حيث تقه أحداث غريبة تهز حياتهما، مما يقودهما إلى اكتشاف لغز خارق للطبيعة يتضمن عائلة أخرى قريبة.‬‬
events.title: هاوس ميتس

events.description: ‫‫يتحول عالم صحفية مشهورة تحظى بالاحترام الكبير إلى كارثة عندما تصبح الجانية في حادث اصطدام وهروب بعد نومها أثناء القيادة.‬‬
events.title: جلسا

events.description: ‫‫يضحي تانهاجي مالوساري، وهو محارب شجاع يعيش في زمن شاتراباتي شيفاجي مهراج، بحياته وواجباته العائلية الأخرى لخوض معركة وغزو الحصون من أجل تحقيق الحكم الذاتي للبلاد.‬‬
events.title: سوبهيدار

events.description: ‫‫يشارك ممثلو وطاقم عمل الفيلم الهندي الشهير (بي كيه) تجاربهم في العمل على المشروع ولحظات من تصوير الفيلم.‬‬
events.title: ذا ميكنغ أوف بي كي

events.description: ‫‫يضع طيارو القوات الجوية الهندية حياتهم على المحك أثناء محاولتهم توحيد قواهم لحماية بلادهم من كيانات منافسة عند شروعهم في مهمة مميتة.‬‬
events.title: أوبريشن فالنتين

events.description: ‫‫يكافح مغنطموح في حياته، ولكنه يحصل على حصته من الشهرة عندما تصبح صديقته عارضة أزياء مشهورة. يبدأ بالإحساس بالتعب بسبب شعبيتها، مما يؤدي لتعقيد علاقتهما.‬‬
events.title: أشيقي

events.description: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.
events.title: China Untapped: Huzhou

events.description: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.
events.title: China Bound：Xiamen

events.description: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.
events.title: China Bound：Suzhou

events.description: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.
events.title: China Bound: Chengdu

events.description: Hainan- the anchor-point of China's southern frontier, its islands custodians of the vast South China Sea! And perhaps nothing embodies the allure of the oceanic wonderland more than the limpid waters of Sansha. From volcanic northern shores to cutting-edge modern cities, join us on coastal journey dotted with historic lighthouses illuminating a fascinating past and guiding the way to a promising future...

events.description: Culture Forward is set at a pivotal moment between the close of China’s 14th Five-Year Plan and the launch of the 15th. The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.
events.title: Culture Forward

events.description: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.
events.title: Awakening Lion

events.description: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.
events.title: The Story of Flying Trident

events.description: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.
events.title: World Heritages in Handan

events.description: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

events.description: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

events.description: Culture Forward is set at a pivotal moment between the close of China’s 14th Five-Year Plan and the launch of the 15th. The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.

events.description: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.
events.title: Awakening Lion

events.description: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.
events.title: The Story of Flying Trident

events.description: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.
events.title: World Heritages in Handan

events.description: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.
events.title: China Untapped: Huzhou

data.description: The hit animal rescue series features incredible and adorable stories of endangered wildlife, vulnerable pets and the people dedicated to saving them.

events.description: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.
events.title: Best Of Pets

events.description: Super eye-catching! Herbivorous animal celebrity appears?! Delicate pets being snubby! They get angry if there's no air conditioning?! Genius horse trainer challenges the rapport between human and horses?! Fresh grass is so sweet that even humans love to eat it?! Growing up with sheep! Experts reveal the secrets of sheep?!
events.title: Cute Pet Guide

events.description: Dr. Matt gets up close and personal with Albert, Flamingoland's 12-foot alligator, as he moves to a new home. Teddy the pet sheep has suspected calcium deficiency and needs emergency treatment, and Marcel the marmoset leads Matt a merry dance around the surgery. Back at Flamingoland, a reluctant macaw needs his beak trimming -V and Matt comes face-to-face with the new pride of lions.
events.title: Zoo Vet At Large

events.description: In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner. The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate. Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?
events.title: The Dog Rescuers

events.description: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!
events.title: Cute Pets At Home

events.description: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers.
events.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud

events.description:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".
But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.
events.title: Scruffts

events.description: Greyhound trainer John Thompson calls on Dr. Matt for help to get his lame star runner back on track. Matt removes a thorn from the greyhound's foot, but the pressure's on to get him fit enough for the next big race.
events.title: Zoo Vet At Large

events.description: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.
events.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud

events.description: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

events.description: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss “Cute Pet Guide”!
